definition: An API Gateway is a server component acting as a single entry point for client applications to route requests, enforce security, apply rate limits, and perform transformation tasks.
detailedExplanation: API Gateways handle cross-cutting concerns such as TLS termination, OAuth verification, request logging, CORS policy handling, and microservice proxying.
commonMistakes: Coupling business logic inside gateway scripts
Not maintaining an OpenAPI specification matching gateway routing
relatedToolTitle: Test API Gateway Endpoints with APIForge
